āhārepaṭikūlasaññā.p: [Āhāre+paṭikū(kkū)la+saññā] (thī) CL=7 The perception which is feeling as it is disgust/loathe for food/nourishment (by nine kinds of state of affairs such as going to the village, seeking and asking for accepting foods).
